name: Bybit BTC/USDT one-, ten-, and thirty-second momentum
description: Causal simple basis-point returns of the fresh Bybit displayed best-quote midpoint over one, ten, and thirty one-second observations. direction_10s is down, flat, or up from the full-precision ten-second return. Any missing or stale one-second Bybit midpoint observation breaks continuity and restarts the 30-second warm-up. This identity is single-venue: it reads only Bybit inputs and is ready whenever the Bybit midpoint ring holds at least 31 contiguous one-second samples, independently of the other adopted spot venue. The blended `btc.external.*` reading of the same measurement stays the reference layer and continues to require every adopted venue (ADR 0024). Decimal outputs are rounded to eight places using round-half-to-even. Venue port (B1): this identity is the Bybit sibling of `btc.coinbase.micro_momentum@1.0.0` and reuses that definition's formulas, windows, thresholds, warm-up, staleness bound, field set, field types and eight-place round-half-to-even rounding verbatim; only the source ids differ (`crates/btc-signals/src/spot_signals.rs`, `crates/btc-signals/src/candidate_spot_signals.rs`). The instrument is Bybit spot BTCUSDT; this identity publishes no price-level field, so its outputs (base sizes, basis points, imbalances, ratios, counts) are quote-currency neutral and nothing is converted. Bybit inputs are rights-gated (`signals/knowledge/RIGHTS-LEDGER.md`): the lane is built and tested to the adopted standard, and its runtime refuses to start unless the environment allow-list `SIGNALS_ENABLED_VENUES` names `bybit`, which the deployment sets only after that row clears. The Bybit midpoint input is the `orderbook.1.BTCUSDT` stream (one level per side, snapshot plus delta); the one-second midpoint is (bid plus ask) divided by two of the retained one-level book. Event time is the venue `cts` when present (`source`) and the local receipt time otherwise (`receipt`). quote_currency is emitted on every decision and is the constant "usd" for this venue: this identity publishes no price-denominated field — its outputs are base sizes, ratios, basis-point and count fields, all quote-currency neutral — so nothing is converted. E47 (USD quoting): this identity quotes in USD and publishes no price, notional or quote-denominated cost field — its outputs are base sizes, counts, basis-point ratios and durations, which are quote-currency neutral — so nothing is converted and no usdt_usd_rate is published. quote_currency is the constant "usd".
